title: Podcast EP375: How to Implement Extensive Security Verification Capability Today with Dr. Farimah Farahmandi
gist: In SemiWiki podcast EP375, Daniel Nenni interviews Dr. Farimah Farahmandi, co-founder and chief scientist of Caspia Technologies, on closing the shortage of hardware security verification talent. Her approach pairs human engineers with trained AI agents run through an orchestration layer while more engineers are trained. The page is a short promotional summary of the episode.

insights.claim: Farimah Farahmandi argues that advanced hardware security verification skills take years of practical experience beyond university training. Organizations therefore need a way to build large security verification teams before enough trained engineers exist.

insights.so_what: A talent bottleneck in chip security verification creates demand for automation tools and EDA-adjacent security vendors.
